description: This Java source file defines the ModelFormFieldBuilder class, which constructs and initializes ModelFormField objects for form configuration in the OFBiz framework. It includes constructors for XML-based initialization and methods for inducing field info based on entity or service parameters, as well as getters, setters, and merge functionality.

classes.name: ModelFormFieldBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing ModelFormField objects, supporting XML initialization, and inducing field info based on entity or service parameters.
